phase_usage_assignment: Native response-completion timestamp. Boundary-straddling response tokens cannot be split exactly.
time_definition: Union of coordinator turn intervals, including model/tool execution; between-turn operator idle excluded. Approval policy never. Native provider backoff inside a live turn is included unless separately observed.
cost_definition: Hypothetical standard API cost, per-response long-context tiers, cached reads as observed; reasoning already included in output. Not a subscription charge or API invoice.

price_snapshot.cache_write_note: Separate cache-write charges are not inferred from unreported fields. Estimate uses observed Codex cache reads; API cache behaviour may differ.

assistance.classification: operator-assisted continuation; original unassisted stop retained
assistance.operator_review_note: Coordinating chat/research is outside the native trial meter; unavailable quantities are not inferred.

native_verification.interpretation: Native observations, not provider-signed evidence. Fresh fork metadata does not by itself certify semantic review independence. Running snapshots may be non-atomic.
